$jsonSchema.title: Player Performance Schema
$jsonSchema.description: Validation rules for player documents containing personal details and nested statistical records.

teamId.description: Reference ID for the team the player belongs to.

PlayerJerseyNumber.description: The number on the player's jersey. Must be between 0 and 99.

PlayerPosition.description: The court position of the player. Limited to standard basketball positions.

PlayerWeight.description: Weight of the player in pounds.

PlayerStudentYear.description: Academic year of the player (e.g., Freshman, Senior).

stats.description: List of performance statistics per season.

Season.description: The specific academic year of the stats (e.g., 2023-2024).

PointsPerGame.description: Average points scored per game. Cannot be negative.

AssistsPerGame.description: Average assists per game. Cannot be negative.

ReboundsPerGame.description: Average rebounds per game. Cannot be negative.
